zh.title: 空中巴士擴建貝爾法斯特機翼工廠　提升A220月產量至13架
zh.summary: 空中巴士擴建貝爾法斯特廠區；擬提升A220月產量至13架並改善計畫效益
body: 空中巴士（Airbus）正擴建位於貝爾法斯特的機翼設施，以支援更高的A220客機生產速率。製造廠區的擴建將用於推動提升產量，目標將A220客機的每月產能提高至13架。
透過擴展位於貝爾法斯特的機翼生產設施，空中巴士期望能為更高產量的A220製造流程提供堅實支援，並進一步改善整個機型計畫的長期經濟效益。
根據 Simple Flying 報導，空中巴士透過擴建貝爾法斯特設施，著眼於提升A220產能至每月13架，同時優化計畫長期的經濟表現。

en.title: Airbus Expands Belfast Wing Facility To Boost A220 Production To 13 Monthly Aircraft
en.summary: Airbus expands its Belfast wing facility to raise A220 production to 13 aircraft monthly.
body: Airbus is expanding its wing facility in Belfast to support higher production rates for the A220 aircraft program. The expansion of the Belfast facility is designed to enable the aircraft manufacturer to boost A220 output to 13 jets per month.

The extended wing production site in Belfast will directly support the increased assembly throughput required for the A220 family. Airbus aims to enhance the long-term economics of the entire A220 program through this facility expansion.

According to Simple Flying, the investment in expanding the Belfast wing facility aligns with Airbus's strategy to raise monthly A220 output to 13 aircraft while improving the economic efficiency of the program over the long term.
